name: cognis-vscode
description: Managed Cognis setup: semantic code search, MCP wiring, and live indexing across MCP-capable editors.

cognis.binaryRepo.description: Advanced: GitHub repository (owner/name) that publishes the Cognis engine release binaries. Leave empty to use the default Cognis repository.

cognis.binaryDownloadBaseUrl.description: Advanced: override the base URL the engine binary and its .sha256 checksum are downloaded from (for offline mirrors or pre-release testing). Leave empty to use the matching GitHub Release for this extension version.

cognis.binaryPath.description: Advanced: use a specific prebuilt Cognis engine binary at this path instead of the managed (downloaded) one. Intended for bring-your-own builds and end-to-end testing. Can also be set via the COGNIS_BINARY_PATH environment variable.

cognis.modelDownloadBaseUrl.description: Advanced: override the base URL the semantic embedding model files (bge-small model.onnx / tokenizer.json / pooling.json) and their .sha256 checksums are downloaded from. Leave empty to use the matching GitHub Release for this extension version.

cognis.mcpConfigScope.description: Where to write MCP client config. workspace (default) writes .cursor/mcp.json inside the target repository so each host starts only the open repo's server (no host × repository fan-out). global merges cognis-<repo-slug> entries into ~/.cursor/mcp.json so multiple indexed repos can stay connected at once; opt in explicitly, as every MCP host then starts a daemon for every indexed repo.

cognis.autoManageOnActivate.description: On activation, inspect the workspace, refresh Cognis config, and let cognis-indexd rebuild or watch as needed.

cognis.autoStartLiveIndexing.description: During auto-manage, start cognis-indexd when the workspace needs indexing or file watching.

cognis.autoIndexOnFileChange.description: When saved files change and live indexing is not running, automatically start cognis-indexd for this workspace.

cognis.promptBeforeMcpWrite.description: Ask once before writing global MCP client configuration during auto-manage.

cognis.autoBootstrapOnOpen.description: Deprecated. Run bootstrap when a workspace opens and .cognis is missing.

cognis.mcpHost.description: MCP config target host. Use auto to detect the current editor (Cursor, VS Code, Kiro). Kiro writes .kiro/settings/mcp.json.

cognis.pollHealthSeconds.description: Health poll interval when live indexing is active.

cognis.mcpSoftTimeoutSeconds.description: Override COGNIS_MCP_SOFT_TIMEOUT_S in generated MCP config. 0 keeps Cognis defaults; generated Windows configs use a safer automatic value.

cognis.mcpHardTimeoutSeconds.description: Override COGNIS_MCP_HARD_TIMEOUT_S in generated MCP config. 0 keeps Cognis defaults; generated Windows configs use a safer automatic value.

cognis.mcpDiscoverSemanticTimeoutSeconds.description: Override COGNIS_MCP_DISCOVER_SEMANTIC_TIMEOUT_S in generated MCP config. 0 keeps Cognis defaults; generated Windows configs use a safer automatic value.

cognis.mcpSemanticCooldownSeconds.description: Override COGNIS_MCP_SEMANTIC_COOLDOWN_S in generated MCP config. 0 keeps the Cognis default.

cognis.mcpWarmSemanticOnStartup.description: When false (default), generated MCP config explicitly sets COGNIS_MCP_WARM_SEMANTIC_ON_STARTUP=0 for lazy first-demand loading. Enable it to emit =1 and preload the embedder on MCP server start. Direct launches with the variable absent remain eager for compatibility.

cognis.mcpStdioMode.description: How editor-owned Cognis MCP stdio servers launch. proxy (default) spawns a model-free thin proxy that forwards JSON-RPC to one heavy repository daemon (host × repository connections cost a thin process, not a heavy one). heavy restores the legacy path where each editor connection is itself a heavy daemon. Can also be set via COGNIS_MCP_STDIO_MODE.

cognis.mcpSharedHttpEnabled.description: Reversible sharing gate for direct shared HTTP (one heavy repository daemon served over bounded-concurrent loopback HTTP). Default OFF: Cognis keeps the compatible thin-proxy / per-repository-daemon stdio path. When enabled, shared HTTP is still withheld until every required gate check has evidence of pass (semantic parity, eight-tool contracts, cancellation/failure, concurrent load/eviction, repository isolation, model-fingerprint isolation, process/private-byte improvement); a failed gate falls back to stdio with no data loss. Can also be set via COGNIS_MCP_SHARED_HTTP=1.

cognis.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the Cognis diagnostics log (Cognis: Show Diagnostics Log). Use debug to capture every CLI call and command with timings when reporting an issue.

cognis.advancedMode.description: Advanced/Debug mode — for developers only. When on, the Cognis panel reveals the full set of detailed controls, diagnostics, and logs. This only changes what the panel shows; it does not affect which commands are available in the Command Palette.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
